essence: Fearlessness, purity, and steadfastness in knowledge-yoga set the frame of the divine nature.
The divine nature includes restraint, truth, and compassion.
The divine-born possesses energy, patience, steadfastness, contentment, and humility.
The demonic wealth consists of hypocrisy, pride, anger, harshness, and ignorance.
Arjuna should abandon inner delusion and perform scriptural action.
